name: webview
description: A real browser in a pane inside Claude Code, opened with /webview, including over SSH. Built on terminal-browser; fork of the zenbu-labs terminal-browser plugin 0.0.2.

agentTool.title: Give the agent a tool to open/close terminal-browser inside claude code
agentTool.description: Adds an open/close tool the model can call to show a page in the browser pane. Off by default.
